create_EMAModule: create an EMAModule instance to track exponential moving average of a PyTorch model with configurable decay
step_EMAModule: call step on an EMAModule to update the EMA weights using the current model parameters
reverse_EMAModule: call reverse on an EMAModule to load EMA weights back into the original model for inference
build_fp32_params_EMAModule: build fp32 parameter copies in an EMAModule to store EMA weights in full precision
restore_EMAModule: restore an EMAModule state from a provided state dict to reload saved EMA parameters
